The Falcons host the 49ers in NFL regular-season play at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. San Francisco arrives unbeaten at 6-0 and winners of six straight, while Atlanta sits at 2-4 after back-to-back losses with 31-23 being the most recent loss to Chicago.

title: NFL Football
description:

The Detroit Lions host the Green Bay Packers in an NFC North matchup at Ford Field. Green Bay has won three straight games, beating Tampa Bay, Chicago and Dallas. Detroit relies on quarterback Jared Goff, who has 1,485 passing yards and 12 TDs.
